items.title: Traditional Arabesque Mandala Medallion Fretwork Door Design
items.description: A luxurious classical double-panel pattern centering a magnificent split circular mandala filled with high-density arabesque floral lace. items.title: Leafy Vine Medallion DXF Panel for Garden Screens
items.description: Overlapping leaf clusters wind around large circular voids, giving the panel a lush, garden-trellis feel at a bigger scale than a typical vine pattern. The open medallion centers keep visibility and airflow generous.
